scope: Initial source-checked research register. Publisher abstracts and listed standard overview only, not exhaustive review or novelty clearance.
claimPolicy: Known techniques are not new algorithms; potential integration contribution requires matched end-to-end evaluation. No comparative superiority or intellectual-property conclusion.

sources.title: Semantic Parsing of Ambiguous Input through Paraphrasing and Verification
sources.known: Jointly generate a meaning representation and a less ambiguous paraphrase from ambiguous input; language-model scores support verification.
sources.sutra: controlled-roundtrip.js reconstructs admitted target instructions; does not generate intended meaning or score paraphrases.
sources.test: Blindly label material qualifiers lost or altered in rendered instructions; compare generated paraphrase with controlled instruction reconstruction.
sources.gap: No automatic semantic parser or independent human semantic evaluation.

sources.title: Towards Transparent Interactive Semantic Parsing via Step-by-Step Correction
sources.known: Stepwise natural-language explanation of predicted logical forms with user corrections in knowledge-base question answering; introduces INSPIRED dialogue dataset.
sources.sutra: clarification-plan.js and clarification-preview.js separate exact declared alternatives and compatibility; workspace supports explicit correction.
sources.test: Matched user tasks: time, number of corrections, residual material errors, accessibility and unsupported answers versus stepwise interactive baseline.
sources.gap: No real user study or automatic interpretation repair.

sources.title: Weakly Supervised Semantic Parsing with Execution-based Spurious Program Filtering
sources.known: Represents programs by results over multiple inputs and uses majority voting to filter semantically divergent programs in weak supervision.
sources.sutra: semantic-counterfactual.js and semantic-witness-search.js expose differing formal behavior; deliberately do not vote away alternatives.
sources.test: Same candidate pool and same perturbation budget: compare observed-only, execution-signature majority, and retained distinguishing-witness workflows on wrong-program detection and minority correct interpretation retention.
sources.gap: No measured automatic parser performance or held-out result.

sources.title: Disambiguate First, Parse Later: Generating Interpretations for Ambiguity Resolution in Semantic Parsing
sources.known: Generates preferred natural-language disambiguations, then fills missing interpretations before logical-form mapping; SQL execution supports interpretation annotation.
sources.sutra: semantic-investigation.js keeps caller-supplied meaning declarations and unresolved facets before and after calculation.
sources.test: Measure interpretation recall and precision on independently annotated ambiguous questions; compare same generation budgets, keeping missing interpretations visible.
sources.gap: Current supplied-candidate mode cannot establish interpretation recall over all plausible meanings.

sources.title: A Truth Maintenance System
sources.known: Maintains reasons for program beliefs and revises belief state by tracing dependencies and assumptions.
sources.sutra: investigation-revision.js tracks admitted dependencies and scoped impact while retaining exact historical input versions.
sources.test: Compare targeted invalidation with full replay and a simple reason-maintenance baseline under source withdrawal, reintroduction and conflicting branches.
sources.gap: Not a general truth maintenance implementation; no full belief closure or dependency-directed search claim.

sources.title: An assumption-based TMS
sources.known: Maintains assumption sets rather than only individual justifications.
sources.sutra: semantic-world-grid.js enumerates bounded supplied candidate and hypothetical quantity assignments.
sources.test: Compare support and counterexample sets against exhaustive finite oracle, measure truncation and repeated assumption reuse.
sources.gap: No ATMS implementation equivalence or general minimal environment algorithm claim.

sources.title: Logic of Belief Revision
sources.known: AGM distinguishes belief change operations and characterizes them with rationality postulates over logically closed belief sets.
sources.sutra: investigation-history.js and sibling-branch-contrast.js preserve conflicting versions rather than enforce global belief consistency.
sources.test: Explicitly compare withdrawal, restoration, incompatible branches, and preserved unresolved evidence; define scoped invariants before invoking belief-revision postulates.
sources.gap: Not an AGM theory implementation or rationality postulate compliance claim.

sources.title: A consistent semantics of self-adjusting computation
sources.known: Formal correctness and consistency of self-adjusting computation; machine-checked semantics.
sources.sutra: revision-reuse-audit.js checks projected cached reports against fresh replay of admitted exact graphs.
sources.test: Matched full replay versus actual incremental execution on shared DAGs, simultaneous edits and interrupted updates; compare full output, runtime and memory.
sources.gap: SUTRA currently still replays full versions, no end-to-end incremental performance or formal equivalence theorem.

sources.title: PROV-DM: The PROV Data Model
sources.level: normative recommendation introduction and model overview
sources.known: Standard provenance vocabulary distinguishes entities, activities, agents, derivation and responsibility.
sources.sutra: Source spans, declared lineage and version digests track restricted provenance and dependency relationships.
sources.test: Map admitted evidence, computation and reviewer declaration into a PROV-compatible interchange profile; test round-trip without inventing agents or source authenticity.
sources.gap: No full PROV conformance, signature trust or empirical source independence.
